examples.explanation: Equal values sit 3 apart (too far), and pairs within distance 2 differ by 4 or more.

hints: Keep a sliding window of the last indexDiff values in an ordered set so neighbours of each new value can be queried.
For each value, check the smallest stored value >= it (ceiling) and the largest stored value <= it (floor); either within valueDiff is a hit.
Evict the value that falls out of the window and use 64-bit arithmetic to avoid overflow on extreme inputs.
title: 335. Contains Duplicate III
